 Live Reporting
 Joe Rindl, Charlotte Coates, Emma Smith & Gary Rose
 Most recent Most popular Boos published at 14:26 GMT 14:26 GMT 
 FT: Man City 1-1 Fulham 
 Shamoon Hafez 
Football reporter at Etihad Stadium 
 Loud boos at full-time here, the home fans are not happy with what they have seen from their side.
 Manchester City's winless Premier League run extends to four games, but give Fulham credit, they were excellent.
 152 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Got to give Fulham credit' published at 14:26 GMT 14:26 GMT 
 FT: Man City 1-1 Fulham 
 Michael Brown 
Former Manchester City and Fulham midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 You've got to give Fulham credit on the day.
 Man City showed some really good touches, good opportunities but they were not clinical enough or not to the standard that is going to win the Premier League.
 91 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:23 GMT 14:23 GMT 
 FT: Man City 1-1 Fulham 
 Well, plenty of talking points. 
 Manchester City's winless run continues, and they're now five points off leaders Arsenal having played a game more.
 But there was big VAR controversy with Erling Haaland's first-half equaliser ruled out.
 Fulham, meanwhile, are now a full three points clear of the drop zone and are on a bit of run.
 242 20 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 FULL-TIME published at 90+3 mins 90+3 mins 
 Man City 1-1 Fulham 
 Boos at the full-time whistle.
 For the first time in 15 years Manchester City have dropped points against Fulham.

 Post published at 90+2 mins 90+2 mins 
 Man City 1-1 Fulham 
 Jeremy Doku hits a cross too hard and the ball goes out of play for a Fulham throw.

 Post published at 90+1 90+1 
 Man City 1-1 Fulham 
 Fulham look the likelier to win this.
 Manchester City don't seem to be too interested in shooting. One effort across the past 15 minutes. I don't understand what the plan it.

 INJURY TIME published at 90 mins 90 mins 
 Man City 1-1 Fulham 
 Fulham have a chance to win it. Sander Berge dribbles into the box but his pull-back is hacked away.
 Three minutes added on.

 We've only had one shot over the past 10 minutes, and that was Cherki's effort which was blocked.

 Empty seats at the Etihad. City continue to lack urgency going forward.

 Man City 1-1 Fulham 
 Image source, Getty Images Now or never time. City are happy to be patient though.
 Fulham aren't really seeing any of the ball at this stage.

 Man City 1-1 Fulham 
 Enzo Fernandez does get minutes today. He replaces Ayyoub Bouaddi.
 101 251 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 84 mins 84 mins 
 Man City 1-1 Fulham 
 Fresh legs for Fulham. Captain Tom Cairney replaces goalscorer Rodrigo Muniz.
 Cesar Palacios also comes on for Ryan Sessegnon.

 Post published at 83 mins 83 mins 
 Man City 1-1 Fulham 
 Image source, Getty Images More like it. City burst forward as Haaland feeds Rayan Cherki, but the substitute's shot is blocked.
 193 94 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 82 mins 82 mins 
 Man City 1-1 Fulham 
 Hmmm, Manchester City looked really sharp 10 minutes ago, but things have slowed down again.
 There's no real urgency.

 Man City 1-1 Fulham 
 Image source, Getty Images Enzo Fernandez is still on the City bench.

 SUBSTITUTION published at 79 mins 79 mins 
 Man City 1-1 Fulham 
 Statement switch from Fulham as forward Gonzalo Garcia comes on for Oscar Bobb.
 Manchester City also make two changes. Allan and Josko Gvardiol and replace Nico O'Reilly and Iliman Ndiaye.
 82 29 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 77 mins 77 mins 
 Man City 1-1 Fulham 
 City clear the next corner and then counter up the other end.
 Calvin Bassey then almost slices a Jeremy Doku cross into his own goal but Bernd Leno is on his toes and makes a diving save.
 This match is too close to call.

 Post published at 75 mins 75 mins 
 Man City 1-1 Fulham 
 Free header! But Rodrigo Muniz nods wide.
 Hang on, the ref's given a corner and Gianluigi Donnarumma then gets a yellow for arguing.

 Fulham win a corner. Time to bring the big men up.
